title: Each filter argument is evaluated in the outer context, not under its sibling arguments
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], FILTER ( VALUES ( Customer[Country] ), [Sales Amount] > 250 ), 'Date'[Year] = 2023 ) )

source.quote: CALCULATE evaluates all the explicit filter arguments in the original evaluation context, each one independently from the others.
source.supports: filter arguments are evaluated in the original evaluation context, each one independently from the others

source.quote: all the filter parameters of a CALCULATE are executed independently from each other
source.supports: the filter parameters of one CALCULATE do not affect each other's evaluation

derivation: FILTER is evaluated with no filter on Year: US 310, JP 230, FR BLANK; only US exceeds 250. Then Country = US and Year = 2023 apply together: rows 1, 2, 3, 4 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 = 210. If FILTER saw Year = 2023, US would be 210, no country would pass and the result would be BLANK.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
